campaniaTender.title: Regione Campania, DD 106 of 1 April 2021, procedure 3248/A-T/2021, Allegato A
campaniaTender.supports: Requires the updated 5 m ground DTM to conform to Level 3 of the 29 April 2001 INTESA GIS specification, attached as Annex 2A, and requires ASCII delivery.

specification.title: INTESA GIS, Prescrizioni Tecniche per la produzione di Modelli Digitali del Terreno, version 16I, 29 April 2001
specification.host: third-party mirror of the primary specification; not an official government host
specification.supports: The GRID-ASCII description states that elevation matrix values are expressed in metres, with at most two decimals. This supports metre scale through the mandated specification, independently of horizontal CRS units.
specification.scope: The format description is presented using a Provincia Autonoma di Trento example. It is documentary support for the governed Campania DTM scale, not a machine-readable unit declaration for the live ImageServer band.

machineDeclared.checked: ImageServer service metadata and keyProperties, WCS 1.0 DescribeCoverage, and exported GeoTIFF GeoKeys. None explicitly declares the vertical height unit or vertical CRS; horizontal CRS declarations do not establish either.

verticalDatumStatus: unknown; neither ellipsoidal nor orthometric nor EGM96 is asserted for the raw band
datumDocumentCaveat: The 2021 tender general geodetic-reference paragraph (Allegato A printed p. 11, PDF p. 36) mentions ellipsoidal coordinates, but the live band has no vertical reference declaration. This does not certify its exported height datum.
decision: Integrate local relative heights by subtracting the sampled opening-street value from the same raw DTM. A common constant vertical offset cancels; this does not establish absolute sea level or certify road-surface geometry.
quality: Native 5 m ground DTM does not resolve all road surfaces, stairs, bridges or walls. The mandated Level 3 specifies approximately 1 m vertical precision; two-decimal storage does not imply centimetre accuracy.
historicalMetadata: Preserve source.json verticalUnits:null/research-only and validation.json verticalUnitsVerified:false as the original acquisition record. This separate review documents the later integration decision; it does not reclassify those fields as machine-certified.
